record.title: FICC/GSD direct netting participation
record.sub: Participate through an account or member
kv: Legal basis

DTCC describes Full Netting Membership as direct GSD participation and names banks, broker-dealers, inter-dealer brokers, FCMs, clearing agencies and investment companies as eligible categories; GSD Rules govern qualification/obligations.
When it applies
A firm seeks direct FICC/GSD netting and settlement as Netting Member.
Named firms

Deutsche Bank AG London Branch (role documented); Citigroup Global Markets, Inc. (role documented); Mizuho Securities USA LLC (role documented); U.S. Bancorp Investments, Inc. (role documented); Barclays Bank PLC (role documented); Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC (role documented); Deutsche Bank Securities Inc. (role documented); BNY Mellon Capital Markets, LLC (role documented); Credit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank, New York Branch (role documented); Goldman Sachs Bank USA (role documented); Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC (role documented); J.P. Morgan Securities LLC (role documented); JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association (role documented); State Street Bank & Trust Company (role documented); The Bank of New York Mellon (role documented); The Northern Trust Company (role documented); U.S. Bank National Association (role documented); Wells Fargo Bank, National Association (role documented); Zions Bancorporation, National Association (role documented)
Who can use it
bank; broker-dealer; inter-dealer broker; futures commission merchant; clearing agency; investment company
Conditions
FICC accepts application under current GSD Rules and membership standards. Applicant meets operative legal, financial, operational, and settlement requirements.
The limit
Listed category is not automatic admission. Direct participation is separate from sponsored, agent-clearing, and executing-firm access.
